headline: Cool Tuesday on Table Rock — crisp fall fishing and a farmers market evening
lede: Tuesday, October 13 brings a cool front with a high near 68°F and low in the low 50s. Light rain chance in the morning gives way to mostly clear skies by afternoon — perfect for a crisp lake day and the weekly Landing Farmers Market.

featured.title: Branson Landing Farmers Market
featured.where: South lot by Bass Pro Shops at Branson Landing
featured.why: Local produce, crafts, live music, and fall flavors. Tuesday-only event — arrive early for the best selection before the evening crowd.

plan.title: Crisp fall bite on Table Rock
plan.detail: Cooler water and post-front conditions have bass moving shallow. Topwater or jigs on main-lake points near Notch. Verify current USACE levels before launch.

plan.title: Lake or indoor fallback
plan.detail: Enjoy the cooler temps on the water or visit one of Branson’s many indoor attractions if any lingering showers appear. Confirm showtimes for evening theatre.

plan.title: Farmers Market & evening stroll
plan.detail: Head to Branson Landing for the weekly market, then enjoy the fountain show and lakeside dining. A relaxed end to a crisp fall day.
